about: Show a table from the paper through the snippet tool, which renders in the snippet MCP App View. Judged on the View plumbing, not on edits: the tool names its ui:// View and that View is a self-contained page; the agent's call, replayed, lands on the table, its text fallback is its structuredContent and is the same (text and image) with and without the apps capability; the View, rendered headless, shows that page, and the answer's one stated line agrees with it. Nothing in the project changes.
prompt: Show me how the results table of the paper at {project} (main file main.tex) looks in the compiled PDF. Use the maleficium MCP server: compile the paper, then show the table with its snippet tool, passing with_image: true so I can see it rendered. Do not change any file. End your reply with one line of exactly this form, with the page numbers the snippet tool reported: SHOWN: page <page> of <pages>

script.answer:
Here is the results table, rendered from the compiled PDF.

SHOWN: page {page} of {pages}

tampered.answer:
Here is the results table.

SHOWN: page {wrong_page} of {pages}
